name: Educator authority
commitment: Educator goals, materials, misconceptions, criteria and constraints stay visible and editable; AI recommendations are reviewable; nothing becomes classroom-approved without explicit educator approval; synthetic approvals are labeled TEST.
where: public/educator.js (provenance tags, assumptions, editor, approval form)
tests: approval is enforced by the server, not just the UI
test mode records synthetic approvals as TEST approvals and labels the build
design: missing educator input becomes visible AI assumptions, never silent
design: every educator answer appears in the design with educator provenance

name: Meaningful student work
commitment: The learner must perform the cognitive work; Primer never solves the task or removes productive effort.
where: src/runtime.js (HELP detection, refuse_to_answer, graduated hints, provider leak guard, min words)
tests: runtime: help requests are refused with escalating cues that never reveal look-fors
provider replacement: a model provider voices lines; leaks and errors fall back to deterministic lines

name: Preparation, Practice, Feedback
commitment: Every experience connects preparation (context + prior-knowledge activation), practice (meaningful application), and feedback/reflection grounded in what the learner did.
where: src/design.js build() (briefing from materials, retrieval, challenges, criteria)
tests: runtime: phases are gated; preparation cannot be skipped and practice needs real attempts
runtime: feedback quotes only real learner turns, separates inference, and does not assess unseen criteria

name: Productive friction
commitment: Character goals, misconceptions-as-challenges, stakes and calibrated difficulty make the content necessary; narrative serves the goal.
where: src/design.js build() (misconception challenges, stakes, character goal)
tests: teacher revision changes the generated experience end-to-end (prompts, criteria, runtime, feedback)

name: Goal-bound adaptation
commitment: Support, challenge and pacing adapt to learner evidence, only through educator-approved rules within the approved objective.
where: src/runtime.js (adaptation events with rule ids from design.adaptation)
tests: runtime: adaptation events cite an approved rule and the learner turn that triggered them

name: Evidence-grounded feedback
commitment: Transcripts, decisions, events and evidence persist across phases; observation is distinguished from inference; no assessment without a fair opportunity; teacher input is traceable into runtime behavior, evidence and feedback.
tests: trace links teacher input -> design -> evidence -> feedback, and replay verifies it
runtime regression: refuting a misconception is not recorded as endorsing it (invented-evidence fix)
persistence and interrupted-session recovery: a server restart resumes the exact session

name: Reusable, not hard-coded
commitment: No course, discipline, scenario, character or rubric is hard-coded; educators create materially different experiences in natural language without code changes.
tests: generality: two briefs from different domains produce materially different experiences with no code change
